data.long_meaning: In Islamic spiritual tradition, Faqirah refers to a female ascetic or a woman of piety and devotion who dedicates herself to the pursuit of knowledge and closeness to Allah. The name Faqirah carries the meaning “Pauper, Beggar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faqirah usually hope their child will grow to embody pauper, beggar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A woman of deep faith and devotion, seeking closeness to Allah.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faqirah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
